rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow, unanimous jurisdictional opinion enforcing the Hobbs Act’s “party aggrieved” participation gate and reversing without reaching the AEA/NWPA merits. Roberts is best positioned to keep the opinion minimalist and unanimous, while Gorsuch/Barrett/Thomas have the highest concurrence risk to elaborate on textualism, ultra vires “bypass” limits, or historical meaning.
